card.name: Punctuation after amino acid residue numbers
card.fires_on: Commas, 'and', 'to' or 'or' right after an amino acid residue name with a number (Glu492, Lys456) in protein structure text. It anticipates another residue name coming next.

modes.label: List separators
modes.description: A comma or 'and' between residues in a list of active-site amino acids.
modes.example: Glu305 and Glu307 in motif A and Glu492<<,>> Glu494, and Gl

modes.label: Mutation wording
modes.description: A linking word after a residue name in a sentence about changing it to another amino acid.
modes.example: Changing Lys456<< to>> alanine or glutamine increases the Km

card.writes: It promotes three-letter amino acid abbreviations like Thr, Gly, Val, Ser and Arg, which suggests it predicts the next residue name.
card.plain: It fires on the comma or 'and' after a residue like Glu492, when another amino acid name is expected next.
